facts.claim: Website discovery: the database has no website_url. The brand domain hf-mixinggroup.com redirects (HTTP, checked 2026-10-27) to www.hf-group.com ('HF GROUP'); the earlier draft's pominirp.com does not resolve in DNS. The Italian entity has no site of its own that was found.

facts.claim: hf-group.com is a client-rendered single-page app: the server answers every path, even a nonsense one, with the same 10,808-byte shell; content comes from a headless CMS CDN (cdn.hf-group.com) with a Cookiebot consent banner. A plain fetch sees no product text, so page reading needs rendering or the sitemap.
Careers: the group site navigation lists vacancies in Germany (DE) and the USA only; no Italian vacancy list is offered.
